name: 北森招聘面试一体化
description_zh: 北森招聘面试一体化工具。覆盖招聘进展查询、面试官待办、面试质量分析、竞品情报分析、招聘需求查询与详情。让招聘面试与需求进展一目了然。
description_en: Integrated recruitment interview suite for Beisen. Covers recruitment progress queries, interviewer to-dos, interview quality analysis, competitor intelligence analysis, and recruitment requirement queries & details. Get full visibility into interview progress and hiring demand.
